title: Set
summary: A set is a collection treated extensionally: its members determine it.

content.plain: A set is a collection treated extensionally: its members determine it.
content.exact: In an axiomatic set theory, set is primitive and extensionality states ∀A∀B[(∀x(x∈A↔x∈B))→A=B].
content.example: {1,2} and {2,1} denote the same set under extensional equality.
content.caveat: Not every foundation takes sets as primitive; this node is a switchboard entry, not an absolute ontology.
